newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rain expected in France by weekend - forecaster.
newsitem.headline: Rain expected in France by weekend - forecaster.

text.p: Light rains are expected to hit western France by Friday and more substantial precipitation may be in store for Saturday and Sunday, the national meteorological service Meteo France said.

"There is some hope for the end of the week. Weak rain are expected on Friday afternoon on the Atlantic coast.We could see more substantial rain on Saturday and Sunday across France, " Meteo France forecaster Franck Baraer told Reuters on Wednesday.
Southern France had scattered showers in recent days but the amount of rain that fell was marginal, he said.
Farmers have been anxiously awaiting any signs of a break in the weather as they fear a three-month dry spell could hit crop potential.
